title: LLM icon matching can assign an icon from another church
reasoning: The prompt sends an allowed ID list to the model, but the parsed response is returned without enforcing that the IDs are in that list. match_icon_to_feast_task then fetches Icon.objects.get(pk=icon_id) globally and assigns it to the feast. A malformed or hallucinated LLM response can therefore attach an icon belonging to a different church, even though the candidate list was scoped to the feast's church.
recommendation: Filter parsed and regex-extracted IDs against the allowed_ids set before returning matches, and in match_icon_to_feast_task fetch the icon with both pk and church constraints.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no included tests for icon_tasks or for rejecting out-of-scope LLM icon IDs.
suggestedRegressionTest: Mock _match_icons_with_llm or the LLM response to return an icon ID from a different church and assert match_icon_to_feast_task does not assign it.
minimumFixScope: Add ID validation in _match_icons_with_llm and church-scoped lookup in match_icon_to_feast_task.
